content: {"summary":"At 10:15 on 8 August 2026 the orders‑api pg pool neared its limit and errors reported no free connections; DNS resolution delays from the pod’s ndots:5 setting and the default pg pool idle timeout caused lookups to block libuv threads, exhausting the connection pool.","likely_cause":"Slow DNS lookups caused by ndots:5 (multiple queries per name and occasional 5 s timeout retries) combined with the pg pool’s default idleTimeoutMillis (10 s) closing idle connections, leading to rapid pool churn and exhaustion.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"pg pool was near capacity with waiting requests at 10:15","evidence_ids":["log:7533"],"quote":"pg pool in use 16 of 25, waiting requests 1"},{"text":"errors indicated no pool connection became free","evidence_ids":["log:7540"],"quote":"no pool connection became free"},{"text":"pg pool max is 25 per pod and idleTimeoutMillis defaults to 10 seconds","evidence_ids":["RB-021#1"],"quote":"pg` Pool (`max` 25 per pod) had `idleTimeoutMillis` at its default, 10 seconds"},{"text":"ndots:5 causes multiple DNS queries per lookup, leading to 5 s timeout retries","evidence_ids":["RB-021#4","RB-021#5"],"quote":"ndots:5 means a name with fewer than five dots gets each search suffix appended first"},{"text":"resolver waits out its 5 s timeout and asks that query again","evidence_ids":["RB-021#5"],"quote":"resolver waits out its 5 s timeout and asks that query again"},{"text":"Node’s dns.lookup uses a libuv thread pool of only 4 threads","evidence_ids":["RB-021#1"],"quote":"has 4 threads unless `UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE` says otherwise"}],"next_checks":["Verify the current ndots setting in the orders‑api deployment","Monitor DNS query loss and latency from pods","Consider increasing UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE to add more libuv threads","Adjust pg pool idleTimeoutMillis to a longer value (e.g., 60 s)","Observe pg pool usage after DNS and timeout changes"]}
